# NetSuite

Accounting · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Oracle NetSuite publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Oracle publishes NetSuite agent skills and Claude plugins in oracle/netsuite-suitecloud-sdk (364 stars). Two finance skills are indexed: the Finance Analyst skill and the SuiteSkills finance runbooks. Both are read-only by default and need your explicit authorisation for any change; none moves money. The other eight skills are for SuiteCloud developers.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://&lt;ACCOUNT_ID&gt;.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com/services/mcp/v1/all** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your NetSuite account. The NetSuite AI Connector; replace &lt;ACCOUNT_ID&gt; with your account id. Address taken from Oracle's documentation, unconfirmed.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Oracle NetSuite

- **[NetSuite Finance Analyst](../../skills/netsuite-finance-analyst/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs NetSuite AI Connector (NetSuite's MCP server) · [source](https://github.com/oracle/netsuite-suitecloud-sdk/tree/master/packages/agent-skills/netsuite-finance-analyst)
  Oracle NetSuite's own finance-analysis skill: statements, budget versus actuals, AR and AP aging, close status, journal entry review and board or CFO summaries from NetSuite data.
- **[NetSuite SuiteSkills: Finance](../../skills/netsuite-suiteskills-finance/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs NetSuite AI Connector (NetSuite's MCP server) · [source](https://github.com/oracle/netsuite-suitecloud-sdk/tree/master/packages/ai-plugins/common/skills/suiteskills/netsuite-suiteskills-finance)
  Oracle NetSuite's own finance runbooks for the NetSuite AI Connector: period close status, journal entry review, flux, cash and liquidity, collections, vendor credit matching, payment proposals and bank reconciliation priorities.
